name: pumi-agents
description: Every space, tab and agent at a glance: who is working, who needs you and who is done, and straight to them on a click.

context.label: Agent context
context.desc: Tell agents about your workspace. Off silences it for every agent.

context_updates.label: Updates
context_updates.desc: Keep agents up to date as panes open, close and move, or tell them only when they start.

context_other_sessions.label: Other sessions
context_other_sessions.desc: Include panes from your other sessions, not only the current one.

context_targets.label: Agents
context_targets.desc: Choose which agents are told about your workspace: `{"claude": true, "pi": false}`.

restore.label: Restore recipes
restore.desc: How an agent resumes its session when its pane comes back, by agent id: the program and its arguments, with {session} for the session. Adds to or replaces the recipes pumi ships; an empty list turns one off.
